title: Sort By Drop-down doesn't has Selected attribute for Options
body:
In the Sort By Drop-down for the options the selected attribute is missing I mean "selected=selected".

**Steps to reproduce the behavior:**
In any Page which has Sort By Drop-down then select any options then the HTML attribute called "selected=selected" is not set.

**Expected behavior **
If we select any options then the "selected=selected" has to be set for options.

Could anyone please help me out.

comments.body:
The **attribute** is not set but the underlying **property** is actually set. You can inspect the selected element from the console. You'll be able to see that `node.selected` returns `true` for the selected option and `false` otherwise. Here is [an example](https://developer.mozilla.org/fr/docs/Web/HTML/Element/select) where you can give it a try. Note that HTML attribute and property are not the same. You can find more information about that on this [StackOverflow](https://stackoverflow.com/questions/6003819/what-is-the-difference-between-properties-and-attributes-in-html) post. 

Do you have a specific use case that requires the `selected` attribute to be present on the element?

Hi @samouss thanks for the reply and yes I need the `selected` attribute to be present on the element. Using jquery on change I need to get the value which has the `selected` attribute.

Is any other way that without using selected attribute I can get the user selected option all times?

Hi, @samouss greeting for the day. I did the same way to get the selected value but why the algolia is not adding selected attribute in default behavior. Because using that selected attribute value getting option value is easier than adding an extra jquery code. Ok thanks, I will try this code and let u know my feedback.
